title: Make errors helpful
summary: An error should say what input was wrong or what action failed. It should not expose private details.
introduction: An error should say what input was wrong or what action failed. It should not expose private details. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An error should say what input was wrong or what action failed. It should not expose private details.

blocks.title: Make errors helpful

blocks.text: The result is 10. Invalid ages would get a message that explains the rule.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Try a decimal age and read the error.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not print secret values in error messages.
For more detail later, use this [Clean Code further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/MDN/Writing_guidelines/Code_style_guide/JavaScript).
